hadith:
Divorce - Narrated Jabir:

A man from the tribe of Bani Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque and said, "I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side. The man turned towards the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and gave four witnesses against himself. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you insane?" (He added), "Are you married?" The man said, 'Yes." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to be stoned to the death in the Musalla (a praying place). When the stones hit him with their sharp edges and he fled, but he was caught at Al- Harra and then killed
message: Allah, the Highest (Al 'Aliyy), is always watching over us with perfect knowledge and sight, so let us be mindful of our actions and turn to Him in sincere repentance when we falter. Those who seek His guidance will find the straight path, while those who turn away from His signs will face the consequences of their choices. May we continuously ask Allah to keep us firm on His way and grant us wisdom to distinguish right from wrong.
name:
Al 'Aliyy - الْعَلِيُّ - The Highest

The name Al 'Aliyy emphasizes the supreme status of Allah, highlighting His greatness, majesty, and unparalleled position above all creation. It reflects His authority and power over the universe, as well as His ability to elevate and honor whomever He wills. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ل ي', which connotes highness and elevation.
verse:
Al-Isra - The Night Journey - 17:96-97

Say, “Sufficient is Allah as a Witness between me and you. He is certainly All-Knowing, All-Seeing of His servants.”

Whoever Allah guides is truly guided. And whoever He leaves to stray, you will find no guardians for them besides Him. And We will drag them on their faces on the Day of Judgment—deaf, dumb, and blind. Hell will be their home. Whenever it dies down, We will flare it up for them.
